title.narrative: Design of Flagship Program on Education for Peace

description.narrative:
At its 220 session, the Director-general has proposed to the Executive Board of UNESCO to launch a new flagship program on Education for Peace that will seek to safeguard and valorise UNESCO’s longstanding efforts to build the defences of peace through education by providing a set of global standards to support countries in implementing education for peace, while upholding the institutions, norms and standards that secure human rights and the dignity of all women and men.
The implementation of the program will be supported by a reinforced central team at UNESCO Headquarters and a network of regional and national/country-based officers.
In the current geopolitical context, it appears that the Middle East region will be a priority in the implementation of this program, requiring specific and dedicated approaches given the several challenges that the region faces. To further elaborate on the initial proposal and provide member States with a detailed implementation plan for this new flagship program in the Middle East region, the senior consultant will:
1. Provide a mapping of all existing tools, resources and partners on Education for Peace and identify specific needs relevant to the targets of the new flagship program in the region; 2. Provide a 2-year draft implementation plan of the Program, including organizational structure at Headquarters, at intersectoral level, and regional and national level; 3. Contribute to the preparation of documents that will be submitted to the 220th session of the Executive Board on the Flagship Program
